## Eip5267Domain.fields property

A bit map where bit i is set to 1 if and only if domain field i is present (0 ≤ i ≤ 4). Bits are read from least significant to most significant, and fields are indexed in the order that is specified by EIP-712, identical to the order in which they are listed in the function type.

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly fields: `0x${string}`;
```
